2609.23423.title: RiverVLN: Phase-Grounded Temporal Vision--Language Navigation for Unmanned Surface Vehicles
2609.23423.paper_summary: Vision-language navigation (VLN) has largely been developed for indoor and terrestrial robots, where language can often be treated as a static goal and motion is approximated by discrete or near-instantaneous actions. These assumptions break down for unmanned surface vehicles (USVs): river navigation requires continuous motion under inertia and limited maneuverability, while long-horizon instructions must be executed through sparse and visually ambiguous maritime landmarks. We introduce RiverVLN, to our knowledge the first benchmark designed for long-horizon USV VLN under continuous riverine motion, and PGT-NAV, a phase-grounded temporal navigation framework for USVs. Rather than directly mapping an entire instruction to motion, PGT-NAV converts it into an ordered sequence of visually verifiable semantic phases and maintains the active phase online through grounded visual and motion evidence. This explicit semantic progress state is fused with visual-motion history and phase-specific grounding to predict six local SE(2) pose increments. The resulting trajectory is executed in a predict-execute-re-observe loop, where the vessel executes toward W3, updates phase and grounding, and replans through a map-based safety layer. Experiments show that PGT-NAV substantially reduces recursive position and heading drift relative to GNM-style and ViNT-style baselines and achieves an average success rate of 0.79 in Unity-ROS closed-loop navigation. Unseen bridge-opening trials and real-world USV experiments further demonstrate that the phase-grounded representation transfers from controlled evaluation to physical USV deployment.
2609.23423.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言導航（VLN）主要是為室內和地面機器人開發的，在這些情況下，語言通常可以被視為靜態目標，而運動則通過離散或近乎瞬時的動作來近似。這些假設在無人水面載具（USVs）中失效：河流導航需要在慣性和有限機動性下進行連續運動，而長距離指令必須通過稀疏且視覺上模糊的海上地標來執行。我們介紹了RiverVLN，據我們所知，這是首個為長距離USV VLN在連續河流運動下設計的基準，以及PGT-NAV，一種基於階段的USV時間導航框架。PGT-NAV並不是將整個指令直接映射到運動，而是將其轉換為可視驗證的語義階段的有序序列，並通過基於視覺和運動的證據在線維持主動階段。這種明確的語義進展狀態與視覺-運動歷史和階段特定的基礎結合，以預測六個局部SE(2)姿勢增量。生成的軌跡在預測-執行-重新觀察的循環中執行，船隻朝向W3執行，更新階段和基礎，並通過基於地圖的安全層重新規劃。實驗顯示，PGT-NAV相較於GNM風格和ViNT風格基準顯著減少了遞歸位置和航向漂移，並在Unity-ROS閉環導航中達到平均成功率0.79。未見的橋梁開放試驗和現實世界的USV實驗進一步證明，基於階段的表示從受控評估轉移到實際USV部署。
